title: Semiclassical Gravity
description: Quantum fields on curved spacetime: what can be said with gravity still classical and everything else quantum. Its two tested predictions - gravity on a quantum wave, and a horizon's glow - point past themselves, to spacetime that is quantum too. Unlocks causal dynamical triangulations in the Monte Carlo Engine.

puzzle.goal: Quantum effects of gravity become as strong as gravity itself at a length built only from the quantum of action ħ, gravity's constant G and the speed of light c. Write that length l.
puzzle.name: Planck length
puzzle.ask: Find l in units of 10⁻³⁶ m (h = 1.0546e-34 for ħ, G = 6.674e-11, c = 2.998e8).
puzzle.method: Only one combination of ħ, G and c has the dimensions of a length. At that size a particle's quantum wavelength equals the radius of the black hole its energy would make.
